QUOTE: It is the value of the first key of the arguments object, or `*` if the arguments are empty or unparseable.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a single argument value (the first key's) reaches the pattern and that empty or unparseable arguments collapse to `*`, which covers the one-value and wildcard-collapse parts. It does not state that the other arguments are invisible, but that follows directly from "the value of the first key", so I graded it as the substance of the item.
